areas.name: Starter City
areas.description: A welcoming city for new adventurers, bustling with activity and opportunity

rooms.title: City Center
rooms.description: You stand in the heart of the bustling city. Merchants call out their wares, travelers hurry between districts, and the occasional adventurer gears up for a journey. A tall town crier stands on a platform in the center, announcing news and important information.

rooms.title: Town Square
rooms.description: A large open plaza with cobblestone paths and benches. The town square serves as a gathering place for citizens and adventurers alike. A beautiful fountain stands in the center, and you can see various shops and buildings surrounding the square.

rooms.title: The Adventurer's Rest
rooms.description: A cozy inn with warm lighting and the aroma of hearty food and ale. The innkeeper tends to patrons at the bar while travelers gather around tables sharing stories of their adventures. Several doors lead upstairs to private rooms.

rooms.title: Temple of Light
rooms.description: A serene sanctuary with high arches and stained glass windows. The temple is filled with the scent of incense and the soft sound of prayers. Priests in white robes move about their sacred duties. An altar stands at the far end, radiating a sense of divine protection.

rooms.title: City Guard Barracks
rooms.description: A sturdy building filled with weapons racks, training dummies, and the sounds of soldiers drilling. Guards move about in organized formations, maintaining the city's security. The scent of leather and metal fills the air.

rooms.title: Guards Post
rooms.description: A fortified checkpoint at the western edge of the city. Armored guards stand watch, checking those who enter and leave. A large wooden gate stands behind the guards, leading out toward the wilds.

rooms.title: City Library
rooms.description: A vast repository of knowledge with towering shelves filled with ancient tomes and scrolls. The air is thick with the smell of old parchment and leather bindings. A librarian tends to the collection from behind a wooden desk, silently cataloging new additions.

rooms.title: The Marketplace
rooms.description: A bustling marketplace filled with vendor stalls and the constant chatter of merchants hawking their goods. The air is filled with exotic smells - fresh bread, spices, leather, and metals. Adventurers and townsfolk browse the wares or haggle over prices.

rooms.title: The Blacksmith's Forge
rooms.description: The hammer-clang of metal on anvil echoes through this workshop. A burly blacksmith works over a roaring forge, sweat dripping down his face as he shapes glowing metal. The shop is filled with weapons, armor, and tools of all kinds.

rooms.title: The City Stable
rooms.description: A large wooden building housing horses and other beasts of burden. Hay and straw cover the floor, and the air is filled with the sounds and smells of livestock. A stable master moves between stalls, tending to the animals.

rooms.title: Central Fountain
rooms.description: A grand fountain sits in a quiet courtyard garden. Crystal clear water flows from a central sculpture depicting a phoenix rising from flames. The sound of the water is soothing, and benches around the fountain offer respite from the busy city streets.
